name: chapter-shell
title: Chapter Shell
description: Architectural scene chrome for a 'light editorial' theme: breadcrumb + step-dot indicator + bold headline/subtitle + a decorative content-card frame at a FIXED rect (top:38cqmin, left/right:6.4cqmin, bottom:5.4cqmin). Draws chrome only -- the real content goes in that rect as a separate, statically-authored sibling data-composition-src scene positioned by the caller (never a nested/dynamic mount; see chapter-shell.html's header comment for why that was tried and empirically disproven).
